description: This file defines the 'Extension' class within the Opencart_Admin_Controller_Startup namespace. It handles startup procedures for extensions in the OpenCart admin system, including loading extension models, registering extension controllers, models, system libraries, and adding paths for templates, languages, and configs. It also registers OCMOD components.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Defines the startup extension controller responsible for loading and registering extension components during system initialization.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method for loading extension data, registering controllers, models, libraries, and setting paths for templates, language, and config during startup.
